features.text: Choose the kit based on the Rebound Dual brace size you already purchased.

features.label: Active grip traction
features.text: A high traction, no slip pad surface helps keep straps positioned against the leg.

features.label: Full strap coverage
features.text: Includes replacement pads for the Lower Cruciate, Bottom, Upper Cruciate, Top, and Anterior Tibial straps.

features.label: Rebound dual compatible
features.text: Designed exclusively for use with the Ossur Rebound Dual knee ligament brace.

features.label: Genuine replacement parts
features.text: Restores fit, comfort, and secure positioning as original strap pads wear out.

features.label: Supports ligament recovery
features.text: Built for use with braces supporting ACL, MCL, LCL, and PCL instabilities.

features.label: Easy application
features.text: Strap pads attach in the same position as the original pads without special tools.

features.label: Cold malleable frame compatible
features.text: Works with the aluminum frame in both OTS and custom configurations.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: Choose the Active Grip Strap Pad Kit based on the Rebound Dual brace size you already purchased. Match the kit to the size printed on your Rebound Dual brace. If the brace label is not visible, compare its thigh circumference, measured 6 in. above mid-patella, to confirm the size. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
